newsitem.title: USA: CommNet to merge into Blackstone in $718 million deal.
newsitem.headline: CommNet to merge into Blackstone in $718 million deal.

text.p: CommNet Cellular Inc. said Wednesday it agreed to be acquired by AV Acquisition Corp., a corporation formed by Blackstone Capital Partners Merchant Banking Fund, in a transaction valued at about $718 million.
Included in the acquisiton will be CommNet debt valued at about $200 million, which will be refinanced.
Following the merger, the companies said affiliates of Blackstone expect to own about 87 percent of CommNet's outstanding shares.
CommNet will continue to operate as an independent public company under its current name and management, with headquarters in Englewood, Colo.
CommNet operates, manages and finances cellular telephone systems in 82 markets in 14 states.
Following news of the deal, CommNet stock rose, closing up $4.8125 at $34.375 on Nasdaq.
The Blackstone Group L.P. is a private investment bank based in New York and founded in 1985 by Peter Peterson, its chairman, and Stephen Schwarzman, its president.
Under terms of the acquisition, the owner of each outstanding share of CommNet common stock can elect either to receive $36 in cash per share or retain that share.
The companies said the agreement provides that not more than about 590,000 shares of CommNet common stock, or about 4 percent of outstanding shares, can be retained by present CommNet shareholders.

Blackstone said in the joint statement that it will invest up to $142 million in the transaction and The Chase Manhattan Corp. has agreed to provide and arrange all of the financing required to complete the recapitalization of CommNet.

The merger agreement includes provisions prohibiting CommNet from actively soliciting another purchaser, the statement read, and provides for the payment of fees and the reimbursement of expenses to Blackstone should the transaction be called off.
Merrill Lynch & Co. acted as exclusive financial advisor to CommNet and Morgan Stanley & Co. advised Blackstone.
